parameters.query:
SELECT 
  a.appointment_id,
  a.patient_name,
  a.parent_name,
  a.parent_email,
  a.parent_phone,
  a.appointment_date,
  a.reason_for_visit,
  a.reminder_24h_sent,
  a.reminder_1h_sent,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.appointment_date - NOW())) / 3600 as hours_until_appointment
FROM appointments a
WHERE 
  a.status = 'scheduled'
  AND a.appointment_date > NOW()
  AND (
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.appointment_date - NOW())) / 3600 BETWEEN 23 AND 25 AND a.reminder_24h_sent = FALSE)
    OR
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.appointment_date - NOW())) / 3600 BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1.5 AND a.reminder_1h_sent = FALSE)
  )
ORDER BY a.appointment_date ASC

UPDATE appointments SET 
  reminder_24h_sent = CASE WHEN '{{$json.reminderType}}' = '24h' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_24h_sent END,
  reminder_1h_sent = CASE WHEN '{{$json.reminderType}}' = '1h' THEN TRUE ELSE reminder_1h_sent END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE appointment_id = '{{$json.appointmentId}}'
